run_generate_yesno_data: run the yesno dummy data generation script to create synthetic WAV audio files
generate_yesno_wav_files: generate synthetic yesno WAV audio files with random 8-bit filenames in dummy_data/waves_yesno
get_yesno_file_name: get a random yesno audio file name with 8 binary digits separated by underscores
create_yesno_output_dir: create the yesno dummy data output directory under the tfds_dir audio/yesno path
run_main_generate: run the main entry point to execute the yesno dummy data generation pipeline
